basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences (AIIMS) Deoghar has released a recruitment notification inviting applications for the post of Junior Resident (Non-Academic). A total of 29 vacancies have been announced across various departments of the institute. Interested and eligible MBBS candidates can apply offline before the last date. This article covers the complete AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident 2026 notification, including important dates, vacancy details, eligibility criteria, application fee, salary, selection process, required documents, and how to apply.

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: Within 15 days from the date of publication of the advertisement on the AIIMS Deoghar website
important_dates.interview_date: To be notified later on the AIIMS Deoghar website

application_fee.details: The application fee must be paid through a Demand Draft drawn in favour of "Miscellaneous Salary, AIIMS Deoghar", payable at AIIMS Deoghar (Account No. 41792595056, IFSC Code: SBIN0064014). No other mode of payment, such as cash, postal order, or cheque, will be accepted.

age_limit.details: Category Age Relaxation Upper Age Limit (as on date of interview) 33 years SC/ST Up to a maximum of 5 years relaxation OBC Up to a maximum of 3 years relaxation Orthopaedically Physically Handicapped (OPH) - UR Up to 5 years relaxation OPH - OBC Up to 8 years relaxation OPH - SC/ST Up to 10 years relaxation | Candidates who have already completed 18 months of Junior Residency will not be considered eligible for this post. The date for determining eligibility with regard to age, educational qualification, and experience will be the date on which the candidate appears for the interview/written test examination.

qualification.details: Candidates must hold a graduate (MBBS) degree from a recognized University/Institute. | Candidates who have already completed 18 months of Junior Residency will not be considered eligible for this post. The date for determining eligibility with regard to age, educational qualification, and experience will be the date on which the candidate appears for the interview/written test examination.

salary_details.details: Selected candidates will be placed in Level 10 of the Pay Matrix with an entry pay of Rs. 56,100 per month, plus Non-Practicing Allowance (NPA) and other usual allowances as admissible.

selection_process: Candidates will be selected through an Interview/Written Test Examination conducted by AIIMS Deoghar. The notification does not provide further details regarding the weightage
or exam pattern for the written test; candidates should refer to the official website for updates once released.
how_to_apply: AIIMS Deoghar is accepting applications through offline mode only. Follow the steps below to apply:
Download the Offline Application Form from the AIIMS Deoghar website.
Fill in the application form completely and paste one passport-size colour photograph.
Attach self-attested photocopies of all required documents listed above.
Attach the Demand Draft for the applicable application fee (if not exempted).
Send the complete application by speed post to: Registrar Office, 4th Floor, AIIMS Devipur (Academic Block), Permanent Campus, Deoghar-814152 (Jharkhand).
Superscribe the envelope with "Application for the Post of JR (Non-Academic)".

Additionally, send a soft copy of the same offline application, along with enclosures and proof of fee (if applicable), as a single PDF file (not exceeding 5MB and legible when printed) to the email ID: [email protected].
important_instructions: Canvassing in any form will lead to disqualification of the candidate. If any information or declaration by the candidate is found false, or relevant information has been suppressed, the candidate will be liable for removal from service. Persons with disability must produce the physically handicapped certificate (with degree of disability) in original, issued by a Medical Board constituted by the Central or State Government, at the time of interview. AIIMS Deoghar reserves the right to amend the number of posts advertised based on functional requirements and to fill or not fill the posts, partially or completely, without assigning any reason. The appointment is on a full-time basis, and private practice of any kind is prohibited. Selected candidates may work in shifts and can be posted anywhere in the Institute at the discretion of the MS/Dean/Executive Director. The appointment does not confer any right to permanent absorption in the Institute. Candidates must abide by the rules of conduct and discipline applicable to Institute employees. All disputes are subject to the jurisdiction of the High Court of Jharkhand. Candidates who resign or are terminated before completion of their tenure must give one month's prior notice, or deposit pay and allowances in lieu of the notice period. No TA/DA will be paid for appearing at the interview. Eligible candidates must report at the Administrative Block, 4th Floor, AIIMS Deoghar on the date of interview (to be notified on the website) with original documents, photocopies, and one passport-size colour photograph. All updates related to this recruitment, including interview dates, notices, and results, will be published only on the AIIMS Deoghar official website.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident Vacancy Details 2026

An additional 5% horizontal reservation for PwD (Persons with Disability) candidates is applicable as per Government rules. faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: AIIMS Deoghar has announced a total of 29 vacancies for the post of Junior Resident (Non-Academic).

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a graduate (MBBS) degree from a recognized University/Institute.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 33 years as on the date of interview, with relaxation applicable for SC/ST, OBC, and PwD candidates as per Government rules.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application fee is Rs. 3,000 for UR candidates and Rs. 1,000 for OBC/EWS candidates. SC/ST/PWD (all categories) and Women (all categories) candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application mode is offline. Candidates must send the filled application form by speed post along with a soft copy sent by email.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 15 days from the date the advertisement is published on the AIIMS Deoghar website. An exact date is not specified in the notification, so candidates should verify the deadline on the official website.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of appointment for AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident (Non-Academic) post?
faq.answer: The initial appointment is for six months, which may be extended, based on departmental assessment and availability of posts, up to a maximum period of 18 months.

faq.question: Q8. Where should the AIIMS Deoghar Junior Resident application be sent?
faq.answer: The application should be sent by speed post to the Registrar Office, 4th Floor, AIIMS Devipur (Academic Block), Permanent Campus, Deoghar-814152, Jharkhand, with the envelope superscribed "Application for the Post of JR (Non-Academic)."
